product_meta.title: Murano Ca'D'Oro Glass Drop Earrings - Gold Filled Ear Wires
description: These striking earrings are made in the authentic Murano glass style. Italian artisans create them by using ruby red molten glass wrapped around a bead forming mandrill. 24 karat gold leaf is applied in the 'Ca'D'Oro' style which crackles and exposes the red glass underneath. The beads are coated with a clear glass protective finish. The beads are then cooled and fired a second time at low heat to set the glass and provide strength and durability. Each Murano bead is unique. The earrings are finished with wavy gold beads, little red Murano glass beads, gold-filled headpins, and gold-filled safety lever back ear wires. They measure 2 inches long including the ear wire with a medium weight feel to them. ​The larger Murano glass square beads measure approximately 1/2 inch in diameter. The final assembly of the earrings is done by hand in our Lapilus studio in the USA. The earrings arrive in a pretty organza gift bag encased in a kraft pillow style box - just add a ribbon and they're reading for gifting!
